_purpose: Per-seat ceiling on the bytes a seat contributes to the generated _STATE.md. _STATE.md is the mandatory first read of every session in every seat, so this is a recurring cost paid by every agent in the fleet. The control refuses when a seat GROWS past its pin. Rules, three-question gate and the fixture-root self-test live in scripts/state/state-budget.mjs.
_howToChange: Lower a pin when the seat actually trims, in the same commit that trims it. Never RAISE a pin to make a red generation green: that converts the growth into a specification and makes the eventual trim read as a regression. Pins are measured as the normalized UTF-8 content that renderCombined reads, not the on-disk file length, so a checkout's line endings do not change the number.
_shape: RATCHET, not a flat budget. Operator chose this shape 2026-09-18 (Variant A in _inbox/2026-09-18_r06_cursor_harness_parity_WDLL.md, items 7 and 8). A flat 32 KB cap would have blocked _STATE.md regeneration for every seat in the fleet until one seat trimmed, which turns a diet into a fleet-wide close outage. This shape is armed today and fires on the next byte of growth.
_defaultPinBytesWhy: A ceiling for a seat that has no pin entry, so a newly registered seat or a seat writing its first STATE.md is not blocked by a pin that does not exist yet. Declared explicitly rather than defaulted in code so there is no silent ceiling anywhere in the control. 4096 is a session state file, not an archive.
armed: 2026-09-18 by R-06 cursor harness parity (doc_repo integration seat)

property.note: Armed at the measured size on 2026-09-18. This is the seat that makes the combined read 230 KB: property alone is 213,766 of 230,044 bytes, 93 percent of every session's mandatory first read. It is pinned rather than trimmed because read-state-first forbids the integration seat writing another seat's state file, so arming produces the named ask with a number attached for the property seat to act on. Any further growth is refused until it trims.

_unpinnedSeats: No pin entry means the seat uses defaultPinBytes. dispatch-planner is deliberately unpinned: it is a registered seat with no STATE.md on disk, so it contributes zero bytes today, and a pin of 0 would refuse its first file and deadlock the seat's first handoff. Generation must never be left in a state no seat is able to clear.
